exposition: Top-down presentation with named probability-estimation and anchor-selection lemmas stated before use and proved later. The unconditional comparison theorem is stated in terms of the degree threshold k; j=log k is introduced when needed for the potential calculation. Compare, Repair, and Refine have pseudocode in Section 3, and ChooseAnchor in Section 5.3. Parameter choices are explained where the proofs need them and collected in Appendix D. In-node DAGs are distinguished from the global comparison DAG, which is explicitly updated alongside the transcript on every answer path.
